[package]
name = "fdb"
version = "0.3.1"
edition = "2024"
default-run = "fdb"
rust-version = "1.89"
description = "Purpose-built durable document and content index for SDB and Fundops"
license = "MIT"

[dependencies]
serde = { version = "1", features = ["derive"] }
serde_json = "1"
# General IEEE checksum implementation; no database/runtime storage engine.
crc32fast = "=1.5.0"
simdutf8 = "=0.1.5"
rkyv = { version = "=0.8.18", optional = true }

[target.'cfg(windows)'.dependencies]
windows-sys = { version = "=0.61.2", optional = true, features = ["Win32_Foundation", "Win32_Storage_FileSystem"] }

[features]
experimental-rkyv-payload = ["dep:rkyv"]
# Opt-in query experiment; default search keeps key-based hydration.
experimental-direct-slot = []
# Grouped page hydration and query-local contiguous payload reads; default off.
experimental-grouped-read = ["experimental-direct-slot"]
experimental-paged-metadata = ["experimental-grouped-read"]
experimental-streaming-open = ["experimental-paged-metadata"]
experimental-wal-delta = ["serde_json/raw_value"]
experimental-shared-documents = []
experimental-builder-budget = ["experimental-write-buffer-budget", "experimental-write-maintenance-slots", "experimental-streaming-metadata", "experimental-merge-postings", "experimental-delta-bitmaps", "dep:windows-sys"]
# Opt-in benchmark/API control; enabled builds still default to synced commits.
experimental-wal-sync-control = []
# Independent flush/merge posting reuse; other write/open experiments are explicit.
experimental-merge-postings = []
experimental-streaming-metadata = ["experimental-streaming-open"]
diagnostic-timing = []
diagnostic-memory = []
experimental-shared-delta-text = []
experimental-compact-delta-postings = []
experimental-delta-bitmaps = ["experimental-compact-delta-postings"]
experimental-write-buffer-budget = ["experimental-write-pipeline"]
# Components can be toggled independently for leave-one-out measurement.
experimental-write-merge-policy = ["experimental-streaming-open"]
experimental-write-record-spool = ["experimental-streaming-open"]
experimental-write-maintenance-slots = ["experimental-streaming-open"]
experimental-write-merge-slot = ["experimental-streaming-open"]
experimental-write-pipeline = ["experimental-write-merge-policy", "experimental-write-record-spool", "experimental-write-merge-slot"]

[profile.release]
lto = "thin"
codegen-units = 1

# This file is automatically @generated by Cargo.
# It is not intended for manual editing.
